arm_contracts.deterministic: Code-owned job parameters and source fixture with seed zero.
arm_contracts.seeded: The identical code-owned parameters and source fixture with seed 47017. Jobs that do not consume seed may remain byte-identical; this is reported, not called diversity.
arm_contracts.random_valid: Uniform shuffled distinct writable cells within the same job region and common protected/fixed/attachment/clearance scopes, matching the seeded job's changed-cell count. Additions select Empty source cells; wear selects declared variable Hard wall cells. It ignores source anchoring, opening-frame structure, endpoint routing and the local topology guard. These are measured outcomes, not silently added capabilities.

shared_controls: Identical source material plane and region per job across all three arms.
Identical host material permission, protected Stone marker, declared fixed/attachment cells, common clearances and 512-cell native ceiling.
Generated opening clearances from the seeded typed proposal apply to every arm.
Every accepted program is compiled by the existing StagePlan and then applied by the existing isolated native Batch owner/executor.
Exact complete source/result planes, program/source/registration identities, raw native receipts and all refused/partial outcomes are retained.
interpretation: Matched deterministic tool and geometric-constraint diagnostics. Counts and connectivity do not establish aesthetic quality, physical stability, machine flow, actor traversal or model optimization.
retained_negative_policy: Refused, partial, failed and stopped cases remain in the fixed 24-case denominator. No native-outcome-driven retries or parameter tuning. Development resource interruptions are separate source/configuration-specific attempts.
fixture_authority: The exact source revision and test_native_detail_jobs.gd SHA bind the explicit code-owned fixture geometries. Source baselines are restored and independently captured by the actual native TileHost before any operation.
